themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents and their role in conducting or assisting with research tasks, including autonomous agents and agent frameworks.

themes.name: AI for product research
themes.description: Content focused on how AI is being used in the early stages of product development, discovery, and ideation.

themes.name: AI summarization insights
themes.description: Articles about AI's ability to condense large amounts of information into key takeaways and insights.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content related to AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles exploring the use and impact of AI chatbots in research contexts, including their accuracy and user interaction.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Content detailing AI's application in the hiring process, from resume screening to identifying potential candidates.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Articles focusing on how AI is employed to automate or enhance the process of testing the usability of products and services.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Content that explores how AI is influencing the design process itself, from concept generation to user interface elements.

themes.name: AI for qualitative research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's application in analyzing and generating insights from qualitative data, such as interviews and open-ended feedback.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Content analyzing the effects of AI on employment, job roles, and the future of work.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
